actionHelp.pkg_install: Installs packages from the device's repositories. Their scripts run as root.
actionHelp.flatpak_install: Installs apps from Flathub for everyone on the device.
actionHelp.pkg_remove: Removes packages, with what depends on them.
actionHelp.pkg_upgrade: Updates all packages now instead of at the next scheduled time.
actionHelp.screen_extend: Gives someone more screen time, for today only.
actionHelp.sudo_grant: Gives someone admin rights on this device for a limited time.
actionHelp.sudo_revoke: Takes admin rights back at once.
actionHelp.user_create: Creates a Linux account on the device.
actionHelp.user_lock: Locks an account so nobody can log in with it.
actionHelp.user_passwd: Sets a start password, shown once, which must be changed at the first login.
actionHelp.group_add: Adds someone to a Linux group, such as printing or media.
actionHelp.group_remove: Takes someone out of a Linux group.
actionHelp.limit_set: Limits how much processor and memory someone's programs may use.
actionHelp.power_reboot: Restarts the device after a warning on the screen.
actionHelp.power_shutdown: Shuts the device down after a warning on the screen.
actionHelp.power_cancel: Cancels a restart or shutdown that is waiting.
actionHelp.notify_send: Shows a message on the desktops of the device.
actionHelp.file_put: Puts a file into an allowed folder of the device.
actionHelp.ca_install: Makes the device trust a certificate authority.
actionHelp.terminal_open: Opens a live shell on the device, as root or as one of its accounts.
actionHelp.access_lock: Locks the screen for some or everyone, until it ends or the device is opened again.
actionHelp.access_deny: Refuses logins and ends running sessions, for some or everyone.
actionHelp.access_cover: Covers the screen with a notice of your own that nobody at the device can close.
actionHelp.access_open: Lifts a lock, refused logins or a full-screen notice.
